Keemart is Meituan's self-operated on-demand retail business in overseas markets. It first launched in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, in May 2025, offering rapid delivery of groceries and daily essentials within 20 minutes . As a key part of Meituan's "Grocery Retail" business expansion overseas, Keemart represents an extension of the company's mission ( We help people eat better, live better. ) in international markets . Leveraging Meituan's mature "front-tier warehouse + instant delivery" model, it is dedicated to providing overseas consumers with a safe, high-quality, and convenient fresh grocery shopping experience .

Keemart is seeking an experienced Merchandise Procurement & Supply Chain Manager to lead merchandise procurement planning, inventory supply, supplier management, and team development. This role is responsible for ensuring adequate merchandise supply and inventory levels, monitoring sales performance, adjusting procurement plans in a timely manner, and managing supplier performance to meet quality standards and delivery requirements. The ideal candidate will have strong data analysis and problem-solving capabilities, proven team management experience, and a solid understanding of procurement and supply chain processes.
q: 5+ years of relevant experience in merchandise and supply chain management.
Strong communication skills and team management capabilities.
Familiarity with merchandise procurement processes and supply chain management processes.
Strong data analysis and problem-solving abilities.
Proven ability to manage supplier relationships and ensure quality standards and delivery requirements are met.
Strong organizational and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and stakeholders.
Must currently work / legally work in: Bahrain
